prompts.text: If your pet could talk for one day, what is the first thing it would roast you about?
Act like a confused GPS and give directions to the toilet in a robotic voice.
What is the most embarrassing thing you have ever searched for on a search engine?
Speak in a pirate accent for your next three sentences. Arrr matey.
What is the weirdest dream you have had that you are still willing to share?
Do your best impression of a goat eating tin cans until someone tells you to stop.
What is the most childish thing you have done as an adult that you are proud of?
Type your next message using only emojis, then let the group guess what it means.
What is the funniest thing that has ever happened to you in public transport?
Narrate your own life for the next minute as if you are a dramatic sports commentator.
What is a song you secretly love but would never admit to in public?
Stand up and do the worm. If you refuse, do ten jumping jacks while singing the alphabet.
What is the most embarrassing photo you still have on your phone?
Send the most recent meme in your camera roll to the chat and explain why it is funny.
What add-on or subscription do you pay for that you could definitely live without?
Introduce yourself to the group as a failed superhero and describe your worst power.
